---
title: "Introduction to R"
---

Welcome to Introduction to R!

## Course Overview

This ad-hoc course introduces students to basic R programming for data analysis. Students will learn how to manipulate data, perform statistical and econometric analysis, and visualize data using R.  

## Useful Resources

### Official Websites
- [R](https://cran.r-project.org/) 
- [RStudio Desktop](https://posit.co/downloads)
- [Official RStudio user guide](https://docs.posit.co/ide/user/)

### Textbooks: Data Analysis 
- [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/)

### Textbooks: Econometrics
- [Using R, Python and Julia for Introductory Econometrics](https://www.urfie.net/) by Florian Heiss: This free textbook is an empirical companion to *Introductory Econometrics* by Jeffrey M. Wooldridge.
  - [Using R for Introductory Econometrics](https://www.urfie.net/downloads/PDF/URfIE_web.pdf)
- [Introduction to Econometrics with R](https://www.econometrics-with-r.org/): This free textbook is an empirical companion to *Introduction to Econometrics* by Stock and Watson, another standard econometrics textbook.      

### Publicly Available Datasets
- [IPUMS](https://www.ipums.org/)
